findings.title: Diff-trimming logic can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of reporting the violation
findings.body:
The common-prefix (`start`) and common-suffix (`end`) are computed independently, so they can overlap. When they do, `value.substring(start, value.length() - end)` has start > end and throws. Example: the English source has HTML, and the translation contains an unclosed `

`. The sanitizer outputs `

`, giving start=3 and end=2 on a 3-character value, so `substring(3, 1)` fails. The same happens whenever the sanitizer inserts text that repeats neighbouring characters, such as a closing tag. The unchecked exception escapes the lambda in `verifySafeHtml`, so the build dies with a stack trace instead of the intended 'Illegal HTML in key ...' message. Clamp `end` to `min(len(value), len(sanitized)) - start` before taking the substrings.

findings.title: Anchor-mismatch message identifies neither key nor file
findings.body: The `santizeAnchors` method receives `key` but never uses it. The message is just "Didn't find anchor tag <a ...> in original string". With thousands of message files and keys, a maintainer cannot tell which file or key failed from this message. The 'Illegal HTML' message does include both. Include the key and `file` in this message too.

findings.title: Lithuanian file now contains an Italian string for totpStep1
findings.body: While stripping the anchors, `totpStep1` was replaced with `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`. That is Italian, not Lithuanian. Lithuanian users will see an Italian sentence in the OTP setup instructions. It should be a proper Lithuanian translation, or the key should be removed so it falls back to English.

findings.title: Lithuanian login file now contains an Italian string for loginTotpStep1
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` was changed to `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian. Lithuanian users will see an Italian instruction on the OTP setup page. Provide a Lithuanian translation, or remove the key so the English fallback is used.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese file now contains a Traditional Chinese string
findings.body: `totpStep1` was replaced with `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：`, which is Traditional Chinese (zh_TW). The zh_CN locale is Simplified, and every other string in the file uses simplified characters and phrasing. It should read something like `在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：`.

findings.title: i18next-style placeholders replaced with MessageFormat syntax in account-ui messages
findings.body: Every other parametrised message in this file uses i18next interpolation (`{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, `{{name}}`). This key was changed to `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` plus `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`. i18next does not interpolate single-brace placeholders and does not support `choice` formats. The account console would then show the literal text `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,...}`. The same conversion was made in the admin-ui resource file (`js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/.../messages_en.properties`). If those UIs render this key through i18next, the message is broken. Keep the i18next syntax there, for example with `{{count}}` plural forms, and only use MessageFormat in the server-side themes.

findings.title: New verifier behaviours are barely covered by tests
findings.body:
The tests only assert that some message containing 'Illegal HTML' or 'anchor' appears. There is no test for the key-specific normalizations (`templateHelp`, `optimizeLookupHelp`, `choice` formats), HTML-entity handling, or `
` normalization. There is also no test for an allowed tag that the sanitizer rewrites, such as an unclosed `

`. The missing unclosed-tag test is why the substring-overlap crash in the diff printing went unnoticed. Add fixtures for these cases.
